title: Windows Support I
subject: Windows Fundamentals
description: Practice home-based support tickets using the 4-step workflow: Triage, Diagnosis, Fix (GUI), and Change Note. Focus: Windows setup, disk storage, local accounts, and file sharing.

tickets.title: User cannot copy a large file to a 16GB USB drive
tickets.summary: A user reports 'Not enough space' when copying a single large file to a USB drive that appears to have free space.

env.User Impact: User cannot move a required file for submission

workflow.triage: Confirm the file size, available space shown, and whether other smaller files copy successfully. Ask if the drive is used across multiple devices.
workflow.diagnosis: Determine whether the limitation is related to the USB file system and/or allocation constraints. Identify what evidence confirms the cause (Properties, file system type, error text).
workflow.fix: Use GUI tools to implement the correct remediation once confirmed (e.g., reformat with appropriate file system, or alternative transfer method if formatting is not acceptable).

validations: Check drive Properties (File system type)
Attempt copy of a smaller file
Validate file copies successfully after remediation

tickets.title: Windows Setup does not show the target disk as installable
tickets.summary: During Windows installation, the target disk is missing or cannot be selected for installation.

workflow.triage: Confirm whether the disk is detected in BIOS/UEFI. Capture the exact behavior: missing disk vs. disk present but not selectable vs. partition errors.
workflow.diagnosis: Determine the likely root cause based on evidence (disk state, partition style mismatch, offline disk, missing storage driver, or unsupported configuration).
workflow.fix: Use Windows Setup GUI and/or built-in disk tools to make the disk usable (safe wipe only if authorized). Document precise steps taken.

validations: Disk visible and selectable in Setup
Installation proceeds past disk selection
Post-install: disk/volume appears healthy in Disk Management

tickets.title: New disk attached but shows as 'Not initialized' / 'Unallocated'
tickets.summary: A user can see a new disk in Disk Management but cannot use it in File Explorer.

env.User Impact: Cannot store files on the new disk

workflow.triage: Confirm the disk is the correct device and capture its current status in Disk Management.
workflow.diagnosis: Determine what is missing for Windows to assign usable storage (initialization, partition, file system, drive letter). Identify evidence for each.
workflow.fix: Perform the GUI steps to initialize, create volume, format appropriately, and assign a drive letter using Disk Management.

validations: Volume appears with a healthy status
Drive letter is present in File Explorer
Read/write test file succeeds

tickets.title: A disk volume is Offline and users report the drive is missing
tickets.summary: A volume that existed yesterday is now missing in File Explorer; Disk Management shows it as Offline.

workflow.triage: Confirm if this is an internal disk, external disk, or VHD. Identify any recent changes (updates, power, docking station, USB enclosure).
workflow.diagnosis: Determine why the disk is Offline (policy, signature collision, connection issue, or protection state). Identify evidence that supports the cause.
workflow.fix: Bring the disk Online safely using Disk Management and document any required corrective steps (only destructive actions with explicit approval).

validations: Disk shows Online
Volume accessible in File Explorer
No new errors in System log related to disk

tickets.title: New local user can sign in but cannot install approved software
tickets.summary: A user account was created, but the user cannot complete an approved installation requiring elevation.

workflow.triage: Confirm the exact failure message and whether elevation is being requested. Identify what actions require admin rights.
workflow.diagnosis: Determine whether this is expected behavior based on user/group membership and UAC. Identify evidence from Local Users and Groups / Computer Management.
workflow.fix: Apply the least-privilege fix (temporary elevation process, admin-assisted install, or proper group assignment if policy allows). Document the GUI steps taken.

validations: User can perform required task through approved method
Account membership matches policy
No unnecessary persistent admin privileges added

tickets.title: User can see a share but gets Access Denied opening files
tickets.summary: A user can browse to a shared folder but receives Access Denied when opening a file.

workflow.triage: Confirm whether the user can open the share root, list files, create files, or only sees the folder. Identify whether the issue affects one user or many.
workflow.diagnosis: Determine whether the issue is share-level permissions, NTFS permissions, or both. Identify what evidence confirms the mismatch (Security tab, Effective Access).
workflow.fix: Use GUI tools to set correct permissions with least privilege (both share and NTFS as needed). Document exactly what you changed.

validations: User can open required files
User cannot access folders outside scope
Effective Access confirms expected result

tickets.title: Technician must prepare a disk using DiskPart (recovery console)
tickets.summary: You are in a recovery/setup command prompt. The disk needs preparation before installation or use.

env.User Impact: Disk not ready for required task

workflow.triage: Identify the correct disk and confirm it is the intended target (avoid destructive actions on the wrong disk).
workflow.diagnosis: Determine what disk state prevents progress (partition table, existing partitions, read-only, offline). Decide what needs to be changed and why.
workflow.fix: Document a safe DiskPart sequence (list disk/select disk/detail disk/list volume, then only authorized actions). If destructive steps are required, clearly note the pre-approval requirement.

validations: Disk shows expected partitions/volume state
Setup can proceed / volume mounts as expected
No unintended data loss (unless explicitly authorized)

tickets.title: Bootable USB preparation requested for Windows installation
tickets.summary: A user needs a bootable USB prepared correctly for Windows installation.

env.User Impact: Cannot install Windows without boot media

workflow.triage: Confirm target device type (UEFI vs legacy BIOS) and confirm user has the correct Windows ISO/Media Creation Tool access.
workflow.diagnosis: Determine what would make a USB 'not bootable' in this environment (wrong format, wrong tool, wrong boot mode, secure boot expectations). Identify checks.
workflow.fix: Provide a GUI-based approach and an alternative command-line approach (non-destructive until confirmed). Document steps clearly.

validations: USB appears as boot option on target device
Boot proceeds to Windows Setup
Media matches correct edition/architecture
